title: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: The youngest angel of New Capenna, too newly formed to fight, who directs the angels through the portals to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A corrupted angel leading Phyrexia's assault on New Capenna who is killed when Park Heights collapses on her.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A winged angel and swordswoman who fights on New Phyrexia and tells Teferi to leave Nissa to her.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads Zhalfir's warclans, slows time around enemies and holds the portal for the retreat.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who builds himself a new body, walks out under his own power and kills Elesh Norn himself.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A Mirran planeswalker who overseas the portal and rallies Mirrans.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who refuses to leave without Nissa and is caught by her.

entities.name: Phyrexian Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Phyrexianized elf who attacks Chandra and is knocked unconscious by Elspeth.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian Grand Praetor, torn apart by her own army and finally killed by Karn.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A praetor who rides a war machine and turns on Norn; he is killed when a Zhalfirin warrior shatters his vat.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A praetor beheaded by an Askari warrior's sword.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who kills the corrupted god Heliod with a dagger.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A Phyrexianized leonin planeswalker who fights beside Norn and is captured alive.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god of Theros corrupted by Phyrexia who is killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Shella
entities.description: An Askari who beheads Vorinclex and helps Teferi up.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad whose burned remains stand as an ashen statue on the tree, with an acorn hidden in the ash.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Karn's dead friend whose death weighs on him.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A dead inventor who gave his life to save Karn.

entities.name: Angels of New Capenna
entities.description: Angels who defend New Capenna and then fly through portals to protect the Multiverse.

entities.name: Demons and devils of New Capenna
entities.description: The offensive forces that fight beside the angels.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: New Capennan engineers who sever the tower's pylons to topple it on Atraxa.

entities.name: Zhalfirins
entities.description: The warriors of Zhalfir who swap planes with New Phyrexia and fight Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The remaining Mirran fighters who retreat into Zhalfir.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Phyrexia's armies that fall into disarray.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The city plane where the angels have held off Phyrexia and where Atraxa is killed.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane of wine-dark seas where the angels arrive to help.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A plane that returns to the Multiverse, swapping places with New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Invasion Tree
entities.description: The structure on New Phyrexia whose barbs retract and which becomes the site of the final battle.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: The glimmering angelic essence that angels become when destroyed.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The New Capenna district in whose structures Atraxa is buried.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The upper city whose workings do not impede Atraxa's scythe.

events.summary: Atraxa, a corrupted angel, cuts through New Capenna's defenses while the angels, demons and devils fight her armies.
participants: Demons and devils of New Capenna
events.quote: She cuts her way through the city's defenses as a farmer threshing wheat.

events.summary: Riveteers hidden in the rafters sever the tower's supports with flame, unseen by Atraxa.
events.quote: Tools used to forge connections are now used to sever them violently in gouts of flame.

events.summary: The tower of New Capenna collapses on Atraxa and kills her.
events.quote: it is the city itself. The gleaming glass and steel tower of New Capenna collapses atop her

events.summary: With Atraxa dead, the Invasion Tree's barbs retract and the angels see portals open to Theros and decide to go help.
events.quote: Atraxa's death has changed New Phyrexia

events.summary: Angels pour through the portal to Theros and protect its people, shielding Kaya as she kills the corrupted god Heliod.
events.quote: When at last she drives a dagger into his throat

events.summary: Giada leads the angels' charge across the Multiverse and speaks with Elspeth on New Phyrexia, promising help.
events.quote: That's just what I wanted to tell you. Some of us are coming to help.

events.summary: The Zhalfirins charge the Phyrexians and Teferi tells Koth the planes are swapping, with Zhalfir coming home.
Koth rallies the Mirrans and the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army.
events.quote: After only minutes on the field, the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army's forces

events.summary: Vorinclex tears Teferi's mount apart and attacks him, but an Askari named Shella beheads the praetor.
events.quote: A blazing sword severs Vorinclex's head from his body.

events.summary: Elspeth tells Teferi to leave Nissa to her and to hold off Jin-Gitaxias and Norn.
The sanctum cracks apart as Zhalfir takes New Phyrexia's place, and Norn rails that Phyrexia will never die while her army turns on her.
events.quote: "Why aren't any of you protecting me!? I am Phyrexia!"

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias's legions attack Norn, and Ajani defends her, until Zhalfirin warriors capture him alive on Teferi's order.
Teferi stops Jin-Gitaxias's war machine blades and a Zhalfirin warrior shatters the vat, dropping Jin-Gitaxias to be eaten by his own creations.
events.quote: Even smaller when his own creations start eating him.

events.summary: Teferi calls the retreat and the Zhalfirins fend off Phyrexians as the Mirrans pass through the portal.
Teferi finds an acorn hidden in the ashen remains of Wrenn and takes it.
events.quote: an acorn hidden within the ash.

events.summary: Nissa attacks Chandra and Koth, and Elspeth knocks her out of her armor and sky; Chandra catches her.
events.quote: The elf drops like a stone out of her armor, and out of the sky.

events.summary: Karn builds a new body and Norn crawls skinless toward the portal as her army tears her apart.
events.quote: Crawling toward them is a skinless abomination.

events.summary: Karn kills Elesh Norn himself and walks through the portal as Teferi resumes time.
events.quote: Karn lays a hand on what remains of Norn's head.

relations.note: Giada is happy to see her old friend
relations.quote: I'm so happy to see you , she calls.

relations.note: Kaya stabs the corrupted god in the throat
relations.quote: When at last she drives a dagger into his throat
As his magic works on Norn's body, tearing porcelain from wire
A blazing sword severs Vorinclex's head from his body.

relations.note: Jin-Gitaxias turns his legions on Norn
relations.quote: "Your ego is a tumor on whatever talent you may have had.

relations.note: Riveteers topple the tower onto Atraxa
Teferi rides at the vanguard of Zhalfir's army
relations.quote: At the vanguard rides Teferi, his staff aglow

relations.note: Teferi says he is happy she is here
